title: Veal Madagascar
description: Veal in a rich cream and demi glace sauce with bacon, capsicum, tomato, onion, garlic, and green peppercorns. Served hot or mild — the customer's choice.

method.instruction: Pan-fry veal in a little butter over medium-high heat until just cooked through, about 1–2 minutes per side. Remove and rest — veal toughens quickly if overdone.
In the same pan, fry bacon until beginning to crisp.
Add onion and capsicum and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes.
Add garlic and chili if making the hot version. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced tomato and cook down for 2–3 minutes until softened.
Pour in demi glace and thickened cream. Stir and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce is rich and coats the back of a spoon.
Add green peppercorns and stir through. Return veal to the pan briefly to warm through.
Plate the veal and spoon the sauce generously over the top.

notes.title: Hot or Mild
notes.content: This dish is made to order — add chili for the hot version, omit for mild. The green peppercorns provide a gentle warmth regardless, so the chili determines the heat level.

notes.title: Sauce Ratio
notes.content: Equal parts cream to demi glace gives a balanced, rich sauce. No red wine is used in this preparation — the depth comes from the demi glace, bacon, and peppercorns.
